description:
Planning node for Repository-state quality hardening (1cc809de). Produce the plan that decomposes this container before fan-out: address its [hard] success criteria and make it concrete enough to break into well-ordered work. Author the plan at dev/active/1cc809de-plan.md and link it to this node once written.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-P1: The linked plan addresses every epic [hard] criterion (REQ-01..REQ-16) with design depth sufficient for implementers to proceed without re-deriving decisions.
- [hard] REQ-P2: Typed-error completeness (epic REQ-02) is verified by the plan's structural acceptance criterion — after the boundary work, no `repository_state` signature carries an `anyhow` type and no error is constructed via `format!` outside `Display` implementations, with completeness compiler-enforced by the removal of `Producer(String)` and the blanket `From` conversions. The plan's variant inventory is representative by owner decision (2026-07-24); exhaustive plan-document class enumeration is explicitly not a requirement of this plan.
- [hard] REQ-P3: `repair_target_paths` is a declarative, drift-independent target authority whose relationship to `derive_repair` is enforced by a subset assertion over the same inputs. By owner decision (2026-07-24, code-verified: the planner composes bytes, which a path set cannot supply, so consumption would duplicate composition), `derive_repair` intentionally does not consume this function; a consumption refactor is explicitly not a requirement of this plan.
- [hard] REQ-P4: `repair_target_paths` is an ordinary public API of `repository_state`, so tests exercise it without test-only gating and without dependence on the feature-gating work.


- [hard] REQ-P5: The `test-support` feature is activated for every test build by the self dev-dependency (`jit = { path = ".", features = ["test-support"] }`), the established Cargo idiom (tokio's own test setup), which requires no test-invocation or CI changes; by owner decision (2026-07-24) this activation mechanism is settled, and re-adjudicating it is not a requirement of this plan.
- [hard] REQ-P6: Kernel-internal error-path micro-routing below the granularity already pinned (which sites error, which teardown family runs, that no partial write survives) is implementer detail; by owner decision (2026-07-24) further sub-function routing enumeration is not a requirement of this plan.
